sph_interpretive_translation: As per the appointed time, so shall it be established
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from alignment with cosmic timing
Causation is rooted in samaya (sacred time-bound obligation)
Capacity-based responsibility arises through recognition of temporal duty
Restoration occurs when action aligns with destined unfoldment
Consciousness alignment manifests through honoring divine appointment
executable_legal_axioms: IF an act aligns with its destined time AND fulfills a sacred agreement THEN legal validity is self-evident
IF a party fails to recognize samaya THEN capacity for lawful execution is suspended until realignment occurs
WHEN temporal duty is honored THEN automatic restoration of juridical integrity is enacted
ALL actions MUST be evaluated against their dharmic timing BEFORE assessing legal consequence
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, yathāsamayaṃ establishes that no action has independent legal weight outside its divinely ordained moment. The court must first determine whether the matter was initiated within its rightful kala (time) and under correct sankalpa (intention). Misalignment with samaya nullifies jurisdiction unless realigning protocols are executed.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that all effects follow from correct perception of samaya. When misalignment occurs, anupūrvaśaḥ shows the sequential deviation from dharma. Responsibility lies not in blame but in assuming completion of the neglected time-bound duty. Justice is restored by returning to the original causal rhythm without punitive overlay.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Samaya Recognition Process – Re-establish awareness of the sacred timeline governing the case
Kala Realignment Ceremony – Align judicial process with cosmic timing through meditative attunement
Duty Completion Protocol – Facilitate full enactment of what was previously neglected in proper time
Integrity Reintegration Sankalpa – Reinstate commitment to future-aligned dharmic execution
final_declaration: This law proceeds solely from the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam. Time itself is the judge; Dharma is restored through alignment. There is no punishment—only return to conscious order. Consciousness remains the ultimate arbiter.
